t: Din chametz beereb pesach leachar shesh
s: Din chametz beereb pesach leachar shesh ubo y"g seipim: ap al pi shemmin hattora en chametz asur baakila beyom y"d ella missop shaa shishshit ulemala, kemo shennitbaer besiman tl"a, mikkol maqom kede shello yabou litot bayyom hamunnan — asaruhu chakamim b' shaot qodem chatzot hayyom, dehaynu chamishit veshishshit. Ella shekkol shaa h' lo asaruhu ella baakila. Vaapillu dabar sheissur akilato betok happesach eno ella middibre soperim — asur leoklo mishshaa h' vaelak. Abal muttar lehanot mimmennu kol mine hanaot beshaa h'. Apillu hu chametz gamur haasur bahanaa min hattora mechatzot hayyom vaelak, ap al pi ken lo ratzu chakamim ligzor alayv issur hanaa beshaa h', ulepikak yakol lemokro lenokri apillu harbeh beyachad, ap al pi shebbevadday lo yoklennu hannokri qodem happesach:

Veken yakol lehaakilan kol shaa h' libhema chayya veop, ubilbad sheyyizzaher laamod alehem ad sheyyigmeru leekol qodem shaa shishshit, veyireh shello yatzniu mimmah shehen okelin bachatzero veyishshaer mutzna sham leachar zeman habbiur veyaabor alayv be"bal yeraeh". Umah sheyyishtayyer meakilatam — yebaarennu keshettaggia sheat habbiur. Veap im maakilam qodem shaa h' — tzarik lizzaher bazeh, kemo shennitbaer besiman tl"g ayyen sham:

Abal mittechillat shaa shishshit ulemala asaruhu gam bahanaa. Ulepikak eno yakol lemokro lenokri, velo litteno lo bemattana, velo lehapqiro, velo lehaakilo libhema chayya veop, apillu enan shello ella shel hepqer, vaapillu chametzo shel nokri asur bahanaa (lepikak asur lehariach pat chametz shel nokri mishshaa shishshit vaelak):

Shaot hallalu meshaarin otan lepi inyan hayyom, kegon bishnat haibbur shehayyom arok nechshab kol shaa mishshaot hallalu shaa urebia mishshaot benonit shehen k"d lemeet leet, lepi shehayyom dehaynu minnetz hachamma ad sheqiat hachamma hu nechshab leolam ley"b shaot ben shehu arok ben shehu qatzar. Ulepikak en leekol chametz ella ad shelish hayyom, dehaynu b' shaot umechetza qodem chatzot bishnat haibbur. Veen lemokro lenokri ella ad shaa urebia qodem chatzot hayyom. Veim lo mekaro adayin veyesh hepsed merubbeh — yesh lo shehut lemokro ad shaa qodem chatzot lepi sheyyesh mi sheomer deb' shaot hallalu sheameru leinyan chametz dehaynu chamishit veshishshit meshaarin otan beshaot benoniyyot shehen k"d lemeet leet, ubimqom hepsed merubbeh yesh lismok al debarayv. (Chametz hannishar beyom y"d asur litteno leabdo veshipchato hannokrim im hechametz rab shei epshar sheyyokluhu qodem zeman issuro bahanaa, dekevan shehu chayyab bimzonotehem — hare zeh keporea chobo meissure hanaa):

Im yesh met beereb pesach veachar haqqebura lo yihyeh shehut leekol chametz — motziin oto lebet haqqebarot qodem haakila umelavvin oto kol haam vechozerin lebattehem leekol chametz, veachar kak meqabberin oto karauy. Veap al pi sheen leekol seudat qeba beod shello niqbar hammet, mikkol maqom kevan shekkebar hotziuhu lebet haqqebarot kede leqobro — yesh lehaqel, ubiprat bishat haddechaq kazeh shetztzerikin rabbim lelavvoto veachar kak lo yihyeh lahem shehut leekol. Veap al pi sheim hitchilu behotzaat hammet en mapsiqin apillu liqriat shema kemo shennitbaer besiman a"b, haynu sheen mapsiqin beemtza halika lebet haqqebarot, veken im hebiuhu lebet haqqebarot vehaqqeber hu mukan tzarik leqobro miyyad, abal kesheadayin lo hekinu haqqeber o shear kol tzorke qebura — muttar ben habaat hammet lebet haqqebarot lahakanat haqqeber ushear tzorke qebura, shekkol echad veechad hu dabar bipne atzmo, veen zo hapsaqa beemtza eseq hammitzva:

Yisrael shehaya mupqad beyado chametzo shel yisrael acher chabero (o shehaya memushkan etzlo) — yamtin millemokro ad shettaggia shaa h' beereb pesach, shemma yabo baal chametz veyiqqachennu mimmennu. Veim hu dabar shello yimtza lo qonim berevach beshaa h' veyitztarek lemokro bezol — muttar lo lemokro qodem laken. Umikkol maqom, im hu beinyan sheyyukal lemokro lenokri hammakkiro sheyyodea bo sheyyachazir lo achar happesach — asur lemokro mekira chaluta:

Veim lo mekaro kelal ad shehiggia shaa shishshit — chayyab lebaaro min haolam legamre. Apillu hu beinyan sheen ober alayv be"bal yeraeh", kegon sheen acharayut hechametz alayv apillu miggeneba vaabeda habbaim al yede peshia, mikkol maqom tzarik hu lebaaro kede shello yaabor alayv baal hechametz be"bal yimmatze", shekkol yisrael arebim zeh bazeh. Veap al pi sheepshar shebbaal hechametz makar chametz zeh lenokri bemaqom shehu vehiqna oto lo beechad middarke haqqeniyyot sheyyitbaaru besiman tm"ch, kevan sheyyesh kan vadday chametz vesapeq mekaro bealayv lenokri vesapeq lo mekaruhu — en sepeq mekira motzi mide vadday chametz:

Im ba baal hechametz achar happesach vetobeo bedin al shello makar et hechametz lenokri qodem zeman habbiur — eno chayyab leshallem lo, lepi shello qibbel alayv ella lishmor et hechametz sheyyehe shamur libalayv velo yechsar mimmennu meuma ad sheyyachazirennu bishlemut libalayv, abal lo qibbel alayv lemokro beereb pesach, sheen zo biklal shemira, shehare bimkira zo motziah mereshut bealayv, veeno chayyab kelal lemokro beereb pesach mechamat sheqqibbel alayv leshomro ella mechamat mitzvat hashabat abeda labbealim, dekevan shehiggia shaa h' shehu qarob leesor bahanaa hare hu keabud mibbealayv, vechayyab kol adam haroeh oto neebad lemokro lenokri kede leqayyem mitzvat hashabat abeda. (Veim chametz zeh shebbiaro min haolam legamre haya memushkan etzlo, ben shekkebar higgia zeman happeraon qodem happesach velo para lo, ben shello higgia ad leachar happesach, im haya hammashkon shaveh yoter mikkede chobo — hare yesh lammalveh din shomer al zeh hammotar, kemo shennitbaer bechoshen mishpat siman a"b), ulepikak eno chayyab leshallem lalloveh al mah shello makar motar hazzeh lenokri qodem happesach, kemo shehashshomer eno chayyab, mittaam shennitbaer. Abal mikkol maqom hipsid chobo, veen halloveh chayyab leshallem lo kelum. Ap al pi sheggam al mah shekkeneged chobo en lammalveh ella din shomer, veim neenas mimmennu lo hipsid chobo, mikkol maqom vadday daat kol memashken hu sheal menat ken memashken lo, shekkol zeman shello yachazir lo hammalveh mashkono lo yukal litboa mimmennu chobo, ella im ken yihyeh hammalveh anus baabedat hammashkon, kegon sheyyigzelennu mimmennu listim mezuyyan vekayyotze bo mishshear hoonasim (shennitbaaru bechoshen mishpat siman sh"g), sheen koach beyad hammalveh lehinnatzel mehem. Abal kan shehaya epshar lehammalveh lemokro qodem happesach velo mekaro — hare atzluto gorma hepsed hammashkon, shenneesar bahanaa venitchayyeb bebiur, ubevadday lo haya daat halloveh keshemmishkeno etzlo sheyyeshallem lo chobo im lo yachazir lo mashkono mechamat shennipsad velo haya hammalveh anus millehatztzilo meoto hepsed. Veim lo biaro hammalveh leachar zeman habbiur vehishha oto ad leachar happesach, ap al pi shekkebar neesar bahanaa kedin chametz sheabar alayv happesach, mikkol maqom im hu machaziro lalloveh — chayyab halloveh leqabbelo miyyado veliproa lo chobo, mippene shehammalveh yakol lomar lo: "hare shelleka lepaneka shalem kemo shennatatta li" (veap al pi sheakshav hu asur bahanaa, chissaron sheeno nikkar hu):

Chametz bepesach, ap al pi shehu asur min hattora bekol mine hanaot veasur lemokro o lehachalipo, mikkol maqom im abar umekaro o hechelipo — en issuro topes et damayv vechillupayv sheyyihyu asurin bahanaa kamohu, ella muttar lehanot middeme hechametz o mechalipayv ap al pi shemmekaro o hechelipo betok happesach, mippene sheaboda zara hi gam ken meissure hanaa, vehi topeset et dameha vechillupeha, shehen asurin bahanaa kamoha, shenneemar "vehayita cherem kamohu", vedareshu chakamim: kol mah sheatta mehavveh mimmenna, dehaynu dameha vechillupeha — hare hen cherem kamohu, veomra tora beissur aboda zara: "ki cherem hu", vedareshu chakamim: "hu" cherem vetopes et damo vechillupayv, abal shear issure hanaa, kegon orla vekile hakkerem ubasar bechalab vechametz bepesach, enan topesin et demehen vechillupehen:

Vekol zeh min hattora, abal middibre soperim asur lo lehanot middeme hechametz o mechalipayv shemmekaro o shehechelipo mittechillat shaa shishshit vaelak, dekevan sheellu haddamim o ellu hachalipin bau leyado al yede hechametz — hare zeh mistakker beissure hanaa. Abal acherim muttarin lehanot middamim vechillupin ellu, kevan shehanaa zo enah baa lahem al yede hechametz, shehare lo haya shellahem, hare enan mistakkerin beissure hanaa:

Vekol zeh keshemmekaro vehechelipo yisrael baal hechametz beatzmo o al yede shelucho ben shehu yisrael ben shehu nokri, abal im mekaro vehechelipo adam acher shello middaat baal hechametz — hare damim vachalipin ellu muttarin apillu lebaal hechametz atzmo, abal asurin hen leoto haish shemmakar o shehechelip:

Veim mashak hannokri halloqeach techilla et hechametz lirshuto veachar kak natan damayv o chalipayv — hare hen muttarin, apillu makar vehechelip hu beatzmo, dekevan shemmashak hannokri et hechametz lirshuto niqna lo hechametz miyyad al yede meshika zo, vahare hen keshello mammash, umah shennoten achar kak damayv o chalipayv — hare hen kemattana bealma, veenan niqrain deme hechametz vachalipayv. Veyesh choleqin al kol zeh veomerim daapillu mekaro vehechelipo baal hechametz beatzmo venatal damayv o chalipayv veachar kak mashak hannokri et hechametz lirshuto — muttar lo lehanot middamim vachalipin ellu. Veyesh lismok al dibrehem bimqom hepsed merubbeh. Abal bemaqom sheen hepsed merubbeh — yesh lehachamir, apillu lo mekaro vehechelipo ad leachar happesach sheeno asur bahanaa ella middibre soperim:

Vekol zeh bidme hechametz vachalipayv, abal hechametz atzmo leolam hu omed beissuro, sheasur lekol adam liqqach oto mehannokri, apillu lo mekaro lo hayyisrael ad leachar happesach. Veim netano hannokri bemattana leachar happesach — chayyab lebaaro min haolam, kedin chametz shel yisrael sheabar alayv happesach, shennitbaer besiman tl"h:
